title: QCR-OS Master Contract
governing_doctrines: KNOWING THE ROADMAP DOES NOT AUTHORIZE TRAVELING IT

articles.title: PURPOSE
articles.description: Establishes constitutional governance over all QCR-OS operations including source qualification, registration, ingestion, storage, integrity, provenance, retrieval, evidence, claims, analysis, AI, workspace, chat, exports, security, and cutover.

articles.title: AUTHORITY HIERARCHY
articles.description: Mandates strict 8-level hierarchy: Human Authorization > Master Contract > Phase Contract > Specialized Source Contract > Executable Policy > Implementation Specification > Legacy Requirement > Reference Material.

articles.title: EPISTEMIC TIERS & SEPARATION
articles.description: Defines 6 epistemic tiers (Tier 0: Quran Canonical & Morphology; Tier 1: Hadith & Sunnah; Tier 2: Classical Exegesis & Lexicons; Tier 3: Scientific & Empirical Evidence; Tier 4: Modern Academic & Thematic Studies; Tier 5: Epistemic Meta-layer & Gaps) with strict separation: Contiguity without conflation.

articles.title: CANONICAL QURAN & BASMALA RULES
articles.description: Inviolable Quran rules (INV-01 to INV-12): 114 Surahs, 6236 standard Ayahs, 112 unnumbered opening Basmalas, Surah 1 Ayah 1 is Basmala, Surah 9 has no opening Basmala, Surah 27 Ayah 30 textual Basmala preserved, zero duplicate keys, byte-for-byte fidelity.

articles.title: STAGE-GATED EXECUTION
articles.description: Strict 12-phase pipeline (Phase 0 to Phase 11). Autonomous transition forbidden. Forward execution strictly blocked.

articles.title: SOURCE VAULT & DATA INTEGRITY
articles.description: Raw sources remain immutable read-only assets under cryptographic SHA-256 verification. Destruction or silent modification forbidden.

articles.title: EVIDENCE, CLAIMS & PROVENANCE
articles.description: Every claim requires explicit typed evidence and traceable provenance before AI synthesis or user display.

articles.title: MULTI-AGENT ARCHITECTURE REQUIREMENT
articles.description: Multi-Agent architecture is registered as a Core Product Requirement reserved for Phase 8, with integrations in Phases 7, 9, 10, 11. It is immutable and not a disposable prototype.

articles.title: CUTOVER & PRODUCTION SAFEGUARDS
articles.description: Cutover requires shadow-mode parity, zero data regressions, and explicit Human Authorization.
